Khalid S: Quick postmortem follow-up - need owners/dates for the DR action items so nothing blocks the April rehearsal.
Mira H: paste the items pls.
Khalid S: TL;DR actions: 1) BGP dry-run + comms script (owner: Khalid, due 2026-04-09) 2) Restore runbook rewrite with manual approval gate + rollback commands (owner: Mira, due 2026-04-05) 3) Snapshot audit + restore timing samples (owner: Devon, due 2026-04-07) 4) Cache priming traffic replay for rehearsals (owner: Khalid/Devon, due 2026-04-08) 5) Wire preflight automation & health checks (owner: Platform Eng, due 2026-04-13) 6) Monthly non-prod restore rehearsal (recurring owners: SRE/Platform).
Devon R: I'll run the snapshot audit. Plan: sample restores across clusters, CSV of restore wall-clock times, flag >45m.
Mira H: Runbook notes: add explicit DNS propagation checks, route table asserts, and a named approver list. Manual promotion for first two rehearsals. ETA 2026-04-05.
Khalid S: For BGP test we'll withdraw a test prefix and verify path re-announcement; comms script will include exact confirmation phrases.
infra-bot: scheduledplaybook: "DR rehearsal - routing & restore" scheduled for 2026-03-31 01:00 UTC. Epic RI-3201 created.
Devon R: Noted recurring pattern: KV cache cold-start spikes after failover. I'll add post-restore cache-validation and seed-replay steps.
Khalid S: Action recap for closure: schedule dry-run, merge runbook with gates, post snapshot audit, add cache priming, set SLI restore <=45m(90p), and confirm monthly rehearsals. Reconvene 2026-04-11 for final signoff.
Mira H: ACK. I'll link the runbook PR to RI-3201 when ready.
Devon R: ACK - will post CSV and proposed retention diffs.
Khalid S: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
